name: SFA: Sales Force Automation
desc: A field sales app for reps on the move: attendance with location, call/visit/sales/collection targets vs. achievement, and pending sales orders, all from their phone.
points: Attendance log in/out with location capture
Target vs. achieved for calls, visits, sales & collections (Today / MTD)
Pending sales orders, beat plans and doctor/chemist visits

name: CRM: Lead & Customer Management
desc: Manages the sales pipeline from lead capture to close: lead KPIs, due dates, assignments and completion for every lead, plus to-dos and notifications.
points: Total / closed / pending / overdue lead KPIs with progress
Lead cards with due dates, assignment and completion %
To-do list, notifications and quotation PDFs

name: ESS: Employee Self-Service
desc: A dedicated employee app split out of the ERP: check in/out with live location, monthly attendance summary, and one-tap leave, loan and task requests.
points: Check in / check out with location
Attendance summary: present, absent, leave, late, overtime
Quick actions: apply leave, loan advance, assigned tasks

name: PB Smart: ERP Management App
desc: The mobile face of the ERP that SFA, CRM and ESS plug into: management quick info across sales, collection, payment, purchase and production, with drill-down reports.
points: Monthly / MTD / YTD target analysis and period quick info
Cash in hand, PDC, expense and VAT status tiles
Production & dispatch status with report drill-downs

name: HouseHunt: Property Search
desc: A property listing app for browsing houses, filtering by location and criteria, and viewing listing details. A personal project outside work.
points: Property listing browse and search
Filter by location and property criteria
In active development

name: Digital Khata: Expense Tracker
desc: A personal and shop expense tracker that works offline first, then syncs when connectivity returns, with Excel export and backup/restore.
points: Offline-first architecture with background sync
Excel export for record-keeping
Backup & restore to prevent data loss

name: To-do List App
desc: A lightweight task manager built to practise clean state management and UI patterns outside work projects.
points: Fast task creation and tracking
Clean card-based UI
